# Kelli White Photography

> > Indianapolis-based brand photography, videography, and education studio serving entrepreneurs and businesses across Central Indiana

Kelli White Photography specializes in brand photography and video services for businesses, wedding documentation, and photographer education. Based in Indianapolis, the studio serves the greater Central Indiana area including Carmel, Fishers, Noblesville, Westfield, and Zionsville.

## Key Topics

- Brand Photography
- Videography Services
- Indianapolis Photographer
- Video Coaching
- Photographer Education
- Brand Sessions
- Wedding Photography
- Wedding Videography
- Food Photography
- Newborn Photography
- School Photography
- Business Branding
- Central Indiana
- Photography Business Education
